units.source_text: 我关上挡雨板，钻进被窝里，可我的心依然阵阵作痛。

en.t: I closed the rain shutters and crawled into bed, but my heart still ached in waves.

units.source_text: 我又去浴池洗了个澡，暴躁地来回划着温泉水。

en.t: I went back to the bath and bathed again, irritably sweeping the hot spring water back and forth.
The rain stopped, and the moon came out.

units.source_text: 雨水冲洗过的秋夜，分外皎洁，银亮银亮的。

en.t: The autumn night, washed clean by the rain, was exceptionally bright, shining with a silvery light.

units.source_text: 我寻思：就是赤脚溜出浴池赶到那边去，也无济于事。

en.t: I thought that even if I slipped barefoot out of the bathhouse and hurried over there, it would do no good.

units.source_text: 这时，已是凌晨两点多钟了。

en.t: By then, it was already past two in the morning.
